text:
6th Avenue N to close for crane work on June 25 in St. Cloud
6th Avenue N in St. Cloud will be closed to thru traffic from 1st Street N to West St. Germain Street between 6:00 am and 12:00 pm on Thursday, June 25, due to crane work in the area, according to a June 24 announcement.
The closure is expected to impact local traffic for six hours while the necessary crane operations are conducted. The city advises motorists and residents in the area to plan alternate routes during this period.
The City of St. Cloud is a municipal government that delivers fire suppression, emergency medical services, hazardous materials response, and community education across central Minnesota. It operates five fire stations with a sixth station and training facility under development, supports public safety programs through outreach and school safety education, and extends its emergency services across eleven counties. The municipality was formed in 1856 through the unification of three riverside towns, according to the official website.
Further updates regarding road closures or additional information about city operations can be found on the city's official website.
